purpose: The service provides real-time fraud scoring for payments by evaluating events as they occur and making decisions within seconds.

components.name: scoring-engine
components.evidence: The new stack is fully declared in Terraform: a KMS key (`scoring_key`), the MSK cluster (`payment_events`), the RDS instance (`decisions_db`), a security group (`decisions_sg`), a log group (`scoring_audit`) and an IAM policy (`scoring_policy`).

components.name: decisions-db
components.evidence: decisions-db (PostgreSQL) stores every decision together with the customer attributes that were scored, and it is the only datastore the engine writes to.

components.name: payment-events (MSK)
components.evidence: The new scoring-engine consumes payment events from payment-events (MSK) as they happen and writes a decision for each payment within seconds.

flows.evidence: The new scoring-engine consumes payment events from payment-events (MSK) as they happen and writes a decision for each payment within seconds.
decisions-db (PostgreSQL) stores every decision together with the customer attributes that were scored, and it is the only datastore the engine writes to.
Every decision writes an audit record to the log group `scoring_audit`; the batch job only wrote a summary line per run.
